name: std::inserter
intro: inserter is a convenience function template that constructs a std::insert_iterator for the container c and its iterator i with the type deduced from the type of the argument.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
c

 -

 container that supports an insert operation


 i

 -

 iterator in c indicating the insertion position

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A std::insert_iterator which can be used to insert elements into the container c at the position indicated by i.

sections.title: Possible implementation

summary: inserter is a convenience function template that constructs a std::insert_iterator for the container c and its iterator i with the type deduced from the type of the argument.
